item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 10:15 AM, 08 November 2026(Sunday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Batangas (Taysan, Rosario, Padre Garcia, Lipa, Ibaan, San Jose, Cuenca, San Pascual, Alitagtag, Bauan, Mabini, Tingloy, and San Juan), Laguna (San Pablo, Santa Maria, Siniloan, Famy, Mabitac, Pakil, Pangil, Nagcarlan, Rizal, Majayjay, Liliw, Paete, Kalayaan, Cavinti, Luisiana, Magdalena, Pagsanjan, Lumban, Calauan, Alaminos, Santa Cruz, Pila, and Victoria), Quezon (Tiaong, San Antonio, Dolores, General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Sariaya, Tayabas, Lucban, Sampaloc, Mauban, Pagbilao, Lucena, Candelaria, Jomalig, Polillo, and Panukulan), and Rizal (Tanay) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Batangas (Lobo and Batangas City) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
